stayType: Small seafront hotel, now trading as The Edge of the Beach (formerly the Edgcumbe Hotel)
accommodation: About 12 rooms, including single rooms and sea-view doubles with a lounge
suitableFor: Couples and surfers wanting a base right on Summerleaze Beach; no pets
parking: Limited on-site parking; a public car park is about five minutes' walk
beachAccess: Summerleaze Crescent, about 200 m from Summerleaze Beach
confirmedFeatures: Bar, free Wi-Fi in public areas, luggage storage, water sports equipment listed
overview: The Edge of the Beach, formerly the Edgcumbe Hotel, is a small hotel at 19 Summerleaze Crescent in Bude, a short step from Summerleaze Beach. The Beach at Bude's own site lists The Edge of The Beach among its accommodation options, so the two appear to be linked.
surfTripFit: Right by Bude's main surf beach, which suits a surf weekend; no board storage is mentioned.

sources.label: The Beach at Bude official site, which lists The Edge of The Beach

gaps: Rename confirmed by Trip.com and The Beach at Bude, but room details are from one booking site. Breakfast availability conflicting; the restaurant may have been under renovation in 2025. Check with the hotel.
verificationNote: Details taken from an online booking site and the neighbouring Beach at Bude hotel's website in October 2026. Surfbooker has not stayed here; confirm facilities and policies directly when you enquire.
